'''Operation Blue Harvest''' was an [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] operation during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. A [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel]] spy once heard several Imperial [[Technician/Legends|technicians]] discussing the project, wondering what it entailed that required large amounts of money and manpower.<ref name="SWCP" />
